name: Martorelles (Spain)
description: White field with a light blue pale at the hoist and a green pale at the fly, charged at the centre with the light green sprig of myrtle fruited light blue of the arms.
history: The council resolved to open the adoption file on 21 September 2015; the flag was approved on 26 July 2016 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 7179 of 8 August 2016. It is based on the arms, incorporating their three colours and the sprig of myrtle: an oblong white flag of 2:3 with the myrtle at the centre, a light blue pale 1/4 of the length at the hoist and a green one at the fly.

features.role: sprig of myrtle fruited light blue, 11/16 of the height
